definitions.explanation: describes something that spreads, permeates, or affects gradually and gently
describes a warm sensation or emotional warmth that spreads through the body or heart

examples.japanese: ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じんわり⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: Sweat started to slowly seep out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じんわり⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
⟦お{風呂|ふろ}→お風呂：00802_ofuro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧じんわり⟦{温|あたた}まった→温まる：02095_atatamaru⟧。
examples.english: I warmed up slowly in the bath.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じんわり⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|し}みた→染みる：10354_shimiru⟧。
examples.english: His words gradually touched my heart.

examples.japanese: じんわり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じんわり⟦{込|こ}み{上|あ}げて→込み上げる：10335_komiageru⟧くる。
examples.english: Emotion slowly wells up inside me.

notes:
ONOMATOPOEIA:
A mimetic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) expressing gradual, gentle spreading

FORMS:
- じんわり - standard form
- ⟦じわじわ→じわじわ：06682_jiwajiwa⟧ - similar meaning, more emphasis on slowness
- じわっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ - momentary version

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- じんわり⟦{汗|あせ}をかく→汗をかく：16925_asewokaku⟧ - to sweat gradually
- じんわり⟦{温|あたた}まる→温まる：02095_atatamaru⟧ - to warm up slowly
- じんわり⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|し}みる→染みる：10354_shimiru⟧ - to touch the heart
- じんわり⟦{効|き}いて→効く：01932_kiku⟧くる - to gradually take effect

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦じわじわ→じわじわ：06682_jiwajiwa⟧ - gradually (more persistent)
- ⟦ほんのり→ほんのり：06275_honnori⟧ - faintly, gently
- ⟦ほかほか→ほかほか：04837_hokahoka⟧ - warm and cozy
